task_description: I want to train a model that summarizes the key points of Korean reports. Please recommend a suitable model and training method.
requirements: The environment has an RTX 5090 graphics card, and each report is about 5 pages long.

data_schema.report: One Korean report body (plain text, about 5 pages long)

prompt_objective: Create a data augmentation prompt suited to the given task and data. The generated prompt should take one data sample as input and generate a new sample that follows the task description, requirements, data format, and schema.
